Voltgrid delays commissioning of its Texas transformer line

Voltgrid Corp has postponed the commissioning of a new transformer line at its Texas plant by two quarters, citing late delivery of test equipment, according to people familiar with the project.

The company said in a statement that it still expects to meet its delivery commitments for 2026. Analysts at two independent research firms noted that the delay could push some shipments into 2027.

Voltgrid has faced earlier schedule slips at the same site, the report said, citing a 2024 commissioning that ran three months late.
